arabic text: PUTRAAN DIYAAN LASHAAN DE TUKRAY RAYIYAAN LABDIYAAN\nWICH SEHRAWAN
english translation text: The mothers of Karbala kept searching\nfor the pieces of their sons' bodies among the desert wedding crowns.

arabic text:
SABAR DE MALIK NU SAIN LAILA AAKHAY
IZN JAY DEWIN TE. MAIN SABAR DI SANJH CHE
AKBAR DE
SEENE CHOON SANGH HATAWAAN.
english translation text:
Lady Layla said to the Master of patience:
if you grant permission,
I will share your burden of patience
and remove the spear from Akbar's chest.

arabic text:
AAKHAY MAA QASIM DI
MAA TE AHSAN KAREIN
DAIR TAEIN LARDA RAWIN.
TERE TUKRAY MUTABIQ
WADHNIYAAN NE
MERE VEER HUSSAIN DI SANWAAN.
english translation text:
Qasim's mother said: do this
favour for me— continue fighting
for a long time.
Your pieces must be gathered
according to the breaths
remaining in my brother Hussain.

arabic text:
JADON QAIDI HO KE
LANGIYAAN MAQTAL CHOON
WAIN ZAINAB KITA.
LASHAAN WAL MAWAAN
NA WEKHAN
KITAY RUK NA JAWAN SANWAAN.
english translation text:
When they passed through
the battlefield as captives,
Zainab cried out: Mothers,
do not look
towards the bodies, lest
your breathing stop.

arabic text:
SAIN ZAINAB NE KEHYA KHOL ABID AKHIYAAN
JAY TE SANWAAN RUKIYAAN.
MAINU SHAM-E-GHAREEBAAN DE WELAY
DEWAY GA KAUN SALAWAAN.
english translation text:
Lady Zainab said: Abid, open your eyes.
If your breathing stops,
who will console me
upon the evening of loneliness?

arabic text:
SHIMAR DE KHANJAR DE WAAR ZAHRA ROKAY NAAL AYE SAIN
KEHWAY.
MAIN CHAKIYAAN PEEAS KE PA LIYA SI KIWEIN HATH GARDAN
TAUN CHAWAAN.
CHODAH SADIYAAN HOIYAAN FATIMA DI NOHAAN AL-AJAL PARH
DIYAAN.
:SAQLAIN: AJAY V TAKDIYAAN NE OH MEHDI PUTAR DI RAHWAAN
english translation text:
With Shimr's dagger upon his neck, Zahra
came weeping and said: I raised him
through grinding the millstones— how can I
remove my hands from his neck?
Fourteen centuries have passed, and Fatima still
recites 'al-Ajal'. O Saqlain, she still
watches the road for her son Mahdi.
